section_summary.extract_value: Section 3.2 presents correlational analyses of body appreciation in men. Body appreciation was inversely associated with conformity to masculine norms, upward appearance-based social comparisons, and BMI (r = -.247, p < .001), while positively associated with physical activity frequency and body satisfaction. Several variables showed no significant associations after Bonferroni correction.
